## Rentvine work-order changes → Mortar
Every 2 minutes: read the most recently changed work orders, compare each status with the last one seen (kept in workflow static data), and send only real changes. People keep working in Rentvine; Mortar follows ("people win").

The first run only records a baseline. Static data persists for active (production) executions only.
Confirm the list endpoint's query parameters in your Rentvine API reference.

Every request to Mortar is signed: the Code node builds the exact JSON string, the Crypto node signs that string (HMAC-SHA256, MORTAR_WEBHOOK_SECRET), and the HTTP node sends the same string as the raw body with `X-Mortar-Signature: sha256=<hex>`. Mortar rejects anything else with 401 and dedupes redeliveries by id.

Needs n8n env vars: `MORTAR_URL`, `MORTAR_WEBHOOK_SECRET` (and `N8N_BLOCK_ENV_ACCESS_IN_NODE=false`). Also `RENTVINE_BASE_URL`, `RENTVINE_STATUS_IDS` (same JSON as Mortar's) and a Basic-auth credential (API key : secret).

meta.description: Polls recent work orders and emits workorder.updated only when a status actually changed.
